carriers.name: Lyca Mobile
carriers.description: 30-day plans, account credit and data add-ons. Website purchases add a 5% recovery fee; introductory offers have separate conditions.

plans.name: Unlimited International 5GB
plans.description: Hotspot supported. International calling to selected destinations included; restrictions apply.
plans.eligibility: Regular price before introductory offers. Compatible unlocked phone required. Website purchases add a 5% recovery fee.

plans.name: Unlimited Plus introductory offer
plans.description: $18 per 30-day cycle for the advertised nine-month introductory period, then $49. Includes 15GB hotspot.
plans.eligibility: New line purchased directly from Lyca online; continuous auto-renewal required. Discount ends if auto-renewal is disabled or fails. 5% website recovery fee extra.

plans.name: High Data 18GB
plans.description: Includes up to 10GB hotspot. International calling to selected destinations included; restrictions apply.
plans.eligibility: Regular price before introductory offers. Compatible unlocked phone required. Website purchases add a 5% recovery fee.

plans.name: Unlimited International 25GB
plans.description: Includes up to 10GB hotspot. International calling to selected destinations included; restrictions apply.
plans.eligibility: Regular price before introductory offers. Compatible unlocked phone required. Website purchases add a 5% recovery fee.

plans.name: Unlimited Plus
plans.description: Includes up to 15GB hotspot. International calling to selected destinations included; restrictions apply.
plans.eligibility: Regular price before introductory offers. Compatible unlocked phone required. Website purchases add a 5% recovery fee.

plans.name: $10 account credit refill
plans.description: Adds $10 account credit. Does not itself specify a service plan or new service period.
plans.period_label: Account credit; no fixed term published
plans.eligibility: Existing Lyca number required. Use depends on account and service terms; website recovery fee is 5%.

plans.name: $20 account credit refill
plans.description: Adds $20 account credit. Does not itself specify a service plan or new service period.
plans.period_label: Account credit; no fixed term published
plans.eligibility: Existing Lyca number required. Use depends on account and service terms; website recovery fee is 5%.

plans.name: 5GB data add-on
plans.description: Adds data to an active plan; unused add-on data expires when that plan ends.
plans.eligibility: Requires an active 30-day Lyca plan; cannot be used alone. Website recovery fee is 5%.

plans.name: 10GB data add-on
plans.description: Adds data to an active plan; unused add-on data expires when that plan ends.
plans.eligibility: Requires an active 30-day Lyca plan; cannot be used alone. Website recovery fee is 5%.

plans.name: 5GB new-line introductory offer
plans.description: $10 per 30-day cycle for the advertised 12-month introductory period, then $19.
plans.eligibility: New line purchased directly from Lyca online; continuous auto-renewal required. Discount ends if auto-renewal is disabled or fails. 5% website recovery fee extra.

carriers.name: Ultra Mobile
carriers.description: Monthly service, a separate PayGo plan, and account-specific add-ons. Taxes and fees are extra; multi-month introductory prices require upfront payment.

plans.name: 4GB - 1 month
plans.description: Hotspot shares the data allowance. Includes calling to selected international destinations.
plans.eligibility: Regular single-month price; compatible unlocked phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: 8GB - 1 month
plans.description: Hotspot shares the data allowance. Includes calling to selected international destinations.
plans.eligibility: Regular single-month price; compatible unlocked phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: 25GB new-customer offer - 1 month
plans.description: New-customer version of the regular 12GB plan. $29 paid for one month; longer terms require larger upfront payments.
plans.eligibility: Limited-time new-customer carrier offer; discount ends if the line is cancelled or downgraded to an ineligible plan. Taxes and fees extra; renewal terms must be checked with Ultra.

plans.name: Ultra Unlimited - 1 month
plans.data_allowance: Unlimited data; congestion-related slowing may apply after 35GB
plans.description: 10GB high-speed hotspot. Video generally streams at about 480p.
plans.eligibility: Regular single-month price; compatible unlocked phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: Ultra Unlimited+ - 1 month
plans.data_allowance: Unlimited data; congestion-related slowing may apply after 35GB
plans.description: 25GB high-speed hotspot. Video generally streams at about 480p.
plans.eligibility: Regular single-month price; compatible unlocked phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: PayGo monthly service
plans.description: A $3 charge renews service every 30 days from the PayGo wallet. Included allowances expire each cycle.
plans.eligibility: Requires the separate PayGo SIM and plan. Wallet must cover renewal and extra usage. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: $10 PayGo wallet refill
plans.data_allowance: Credit used for metered data or passes
plans.description: Adds $10 to the PayGo wallet for renewal, usage or eligible passes.
plans.eligibility: PayGo accounts only; ordinary Ultra recharge cards are not compatible. The $3 service charge is deducted separately.

plans.name: PayGo 1GB data pass
plans.description: Adds 1GB for seven days to an active PayGo account.
plans.eligibility: PayGo only; does not work on suspended accounts. Another data pass cannot be added until the current high-speed data is exhausted.

plans.name: $20 UpRoam credit
plans.data_allowance: Metered roaming data; destination rates apply
plans.description: Adds international roaming credit; unused credit rolls into the next billing month.
plans.eligibility: Requires an eligible active standard Ultra plan. PayGo uses its own wallet and has no data roaming. Destination and device restrictions apply.

plans.name: 4GB introductory 3-month offer
plans.description: $30 prepaid for three months, equivalent to $10 per month. Full-price options apply after the first term.
plans.eligibility: New customers; initial term only. Taxes and fees extra. Carrier offer; availability must be checked directly with Ultra.

carriers.name: H2O Wireless
carriers.description: Monthly plans, prepaid multi-month service, PAYG credit and rollover data top-ups. Listed prices exclude taxes and fees; AutoPay discounts require enrollment.

plans.name: 10GB - $20 monthly
plans.description: 2GB hotspot included. Selected international calls included.
plans.eligibility: Regular price; $18 with carrier AutoPay enrollment. Compatible phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: Unlimited - $30 monthly
plans.description: 5GB hotspot included. Selected international calls included.
plans.eligibility: Regular price; $27 with carrier AutoPay enrollment. Compatible phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: Unlimited - $40 monthly
plans.description: 10GB hotspot included. Selected international calls included.
plans.eligibility: Regular price; $36 with carrier AutoPay enrollment. Compatible phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: Unlimited - $50 monthly
plans.description: 15GB hotspot included. Selected international calls included.
plans.eligibility: Regular price; $45 with carrier AutoPay enrollment. Compatible phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: Unlimited - $60 monthly
plans.description: 20GB hotspot included. Selected international calls included.
plans.eligibility: Regular price; $54 with carrier AutoPay enrollment. Compatible phone required. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: $10 Pay As You Go credit
plans.description: $10 shared usage credit; service stops when credit runs out. MMS consumes data.
plans.period_label: 90 days or until credit is used
plans.eligibility: H2O PAYG account required. Recharge the same denomination before expiry for balance rollover. $9 with AutoPay; taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: $100 Pay As You Go credit
plans.description: $100 shared usage credit; service stops when credit runs out. MMS consumes data.
plans.period_label: 365 days or until credit is used
plans.eligibility: H2O PAYG account required. Recharge the same denomination before expiry for balance rollover. $90 with AutoPay; taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: 2GB data top-up
plans.description: Used after the plan's included data. Unused top-up data rolls over with continuous renewal of the same plan.
plans.period_label: Until used; continuous same-plan renewal required
plans.eligibility: Active H2O Monthly Unlimited plan required. Balance is forfeited on expiry, cancellation or a plan change. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: 5GB data top-up
plans.description: Used after the plan's included data. Unused top-up data rolls over with continuous renewal of the same plan.
plans.period_label: Until used; continuous same-plan renewal required
plans.eligibility: Active H2O Monthly Unlimited plan required. Balance is forfeited on expiry, cancellation or a plan change. Taxes and fees extra.

plans.name: 10GB - 12 months prepaid
plans.data_allowance: 10GB high-speed data per monthly cycle, then reduced speeds
plans.description: $192 upfront, equivalent to $16 per month. Includes 2GB hotspot per monthly cycle.
plans.eligibility: Full-term advance payment required. No introductory new-line condition stated on the current plan card. No additional AutoPay discount applied; taxes and fees extra.
